card.name: Invasive plant and weed control texts
card.fires_on: Punctuation, short linking words and name parts inside texts about invasive plants, weeds and their control. It sits where words like native, invasive or control could come next.

modes.label: Verb before native ecosystems
modes.description: A verb just before the word native in conservation text about plant invasions.

card.writes: It promotes native, indigenous and control, and suppresses host and pest, so it pushes toward native-species and control wording.
card.plain: It lights up in invasive weed and pest control writing, on small words and punctuation where talk of native species or control is likely to follow.
